confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence. They are based on a few 2025-2026 travel and cost-of-living guides that disagree, so they are bounded estimates rather than official price data. Accommodation anchors are low confidence, holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Naples July tourist-season context. They were not checked against live booking pages or current listings. FX is stale: the only RBA-attributed observation I could verify is from 2026-03-20, and I could not confirm the latest RBA observation as of 2026-11-19.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southern Italian mid-sized tourist city, benchmarked against Italian price levels for trattoria and pizzeria meals, bar coffee, and aperitivo drinks, with the Naples discount to central tourist hubs applied. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for July demand in a mid-sized Italian city.
